rationale: Extends Town Shop fulfillment through Day 30 to monetize peak harvest cycles at 2.0x-3.5x contract premiums while synchronizing seed procurement with crop growth horizons (halting Pumpkins Day 23, Tomatoes Day 25, Carrots Day 27, and pivoting to rapid-cycle Wheat on Days 28-29). Overhauls farm execution with cluster harvesting and pre-seeding fertilizer application to eliminate transit bottlenecks and double per-plot yield, while replacing panic dumping with protected cyclical monetization (>=1.15x base price for non-shop surplus, raising shed relief floors to 0.85x) and bounding contiguous land scaling to 18 plots with a secure reinvestment buffer.
